# xmesh

> Connect selected development workspaces to local clients, other devices and cloud agents over MCP.

## Installation and setup

- [Agent guide](docs/agent/README.md): version-pinned setup workflow and readiness states.
- [Installation](docs/agent/install.md): native bootstrap, verified downloads and offline bundles.
- [Setup](docs/agent/setup.md): inspect, plan, apply, status, resume, verify and doctor.
- [Clients](docs/agent/clients.md): Codex, Claude Code, cloud connectors and reload/verification.
- [Examples](docs/agent/examples.md): local, multiple-computer and cloud setup requests and success criteria.
- [Troubleshooting](docs/agent/troubleshooting.md): result codes and concrete repair actions.
- [Recovery](docs/agent/recovery.md): stable failure phases and recovery actions.
- [Operations](docs/operations.md): runtime, pairing and network operations.
- [Acceptance](docs/validation/real-environment-runbook.md): real-device validation.
